summary_en: 115,000 shares (1.00% S/O); ¥300M upper limit; execution window 2026-06-08 to 2026-12-07; method: market purchase via discretionary trading agreement on TSE Growth Market.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares (Acquisition of treasury shares pursuant to Company Code Article 165, Paragraph 2, based on articles of incorporation)
translation_en_brief: On 5 June 2026, the board of Kusurinomadoguchi, Inc. (ticker 5592, TSE Growth Market) resolved to acquire treasury shares pursuant to Company Code Article 156 (read in light of Article 165, paragraph 2). The company will acquire up to 115,000 ordinary shares, representing 1.00% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares), for a maximum outlay of ¥300 million. Execution will occur via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading agreement between 8 June 2026 and 7 December 2026 (settlement date basis). The stated rationale is to improve capital efficiency, return capital to shareholders, and enable flexible capital allocation decisions. As of 31 March 2026, the company held no treasury shares against 11,458,582 shares outstanding (excluding treasury shares).
